libvpx 1.12.0 as Debian 12 ships it (source package 1.12.0-1+deb12u5, its patches applied):
the VP8 encoder and decoder only, configured on arm64 with
  ./configure --target=arm64-linux-gcc --disable-vp9 --disable-examples --disable-tools --disable-docs
    --disable-unit-tests --enable-static --disable-shared --disable-runtime-cpu-detect --enable-pic
    --disable-postproc --size-limit=16384x16384
The generated vpx_config.h, vpx_config.c, *_rtcd.h and vpx_version.h are kept; SOURCES.txt lists
the files that configuration compiles (crates/video/build.rs compiles them); headers of other
architectures are left out. BSD-3-Clause with the WebM project patent grant (LICENSE, PATENTS).
